QuestInfo.name: Rolonay's Request 1
QuestInfo.0: You took care of the Starfishes for #b#p1092004##k. Nice work! Better report back to #b#p1094000##k now.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1094000##k wants you to let #b#p1092012##k know that the monsters are all gone. Even though #p1092012# is a monster himself, he's scared of his brethren and would rather spend his time on the bottom deck of Nautilus, doing his research.
QuestInfo.2: You told #b#p1092012##k that the beach is free of monsters, so he can come out if he wants to.

0.0: Hm. #p1092004##k's workin' pretty hard after all, eh? Good kid. \r\nWith the monsters all gone, maybe #b#p1092012##k can finally get out on the beach and enjoy himself for once.\r\n
0.1: Ya know #b#p1092012##k, right? He's only the smartest monster on Nautilus! Don't worry, he's on our side. He's always in his room, fussin' around with his books and whatnot.
0.2: Hey, if you're not busy, why don't you tell #b#p1092012##k that the beach is clear? The guy's all pasty and such. He could use some sun.\r\n

yes.0: #b#p1092012##k's on the bottom deck of Nautilus, I bet. Don't worry, ya can't miss him!

no.0: C'mon! Rolonay's been locked away in his room for weeks. He could really use the break!

1.0: What is it? I'm busy!\r\nThe beach is free of monsters? ...And?\r\n

yes.0: Oh dear. I'm afraid our friend #b#p1094000##k is quite mistaken. I'm not afraid of the monsters on the beach at all.

npc.0: Let #b#p1092012##k know the good news. I bet'cha he'll be thrilled!
